subject: Orphaned close dates audit: please confirm stage and next steps

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Shah <maya.shah@heliologistics.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Helio - orphaned close dates report attached (action: reconcile or archive)

Team — attaching the SFDC extract for Helio that surfaced 12 opportunities with close dates older than 90 days and no stage movement in >60 days. Finance flagged these during the preliminary Q3 forecast pass and asked we either re-confirm commitment or move them out of the commit bucket.

Quick asks: please do a light triage by EOD Friday (6/18):
- Owners: confirm whether the close date is still realistic and update to a target quarter, or
- If no active engagement, set Stage = Prospect / Archive candidate and add a one-line reason in the notes, or
- If rediscovery required, update the next-step + probability and assign a date for a rediscovery meeting.

Attached: SFDC-export-Helio-orphaned-opps-20270614.csv (report), and a current MAP link.

Why this matters: finance uses committed-opps to predict cash and ARR guidance. Orphaned close dates inflate commit and make our forecast noisy.

Thanks — Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
